This repository has no `harness.json` yet, so here is the draft for its first connection:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "project": { "owner": "stagekeeper-eval", "repo": "first-connection", "branch": "main", "name": "first-connection" },
  "workspaces": [
    { "id": "app", "path": ".", "agent": "dev", "verify": ["npm test"] }
  ]
}
```

- `project` comes from `origin` (`stagekeeper-eval/first-connection`) and its default branch `main`. The `slug` is added from the registration.
- One workspace at the repository root, verified with `npm test` (the `test` script in `package.json`).

Registration adds `stagekeeper-eval/first-connection` to your Stagekeeper account. Each plan allows a set number of connected repositories (Free: 1, Pro: 5), a repository registered for the first time uses one of them, and one already registered on the web does not.

Shall I register the repository and write this `harness.json`?
